chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

exercises.name: Meet the guitar
exercises.purpose: Learn the names of the parts so instructions make sense.

params.hold: Rest the body on your right thigh; neck points slightly up and left.

exercises.coaching: This is the headstock — the knobs up here change the pitch. These are frets — the spaces on the neck. Low E is the fat string, high e is the thin one. That is all the vocabulary you need today.

exercises.name: Tune up with the free tuner
exercises.purpose: Train your ear and your hands to a tuned instrument.

params.target: E A D G B E (low to high)
params.action: Pluck each open string; match the tuner dot; tighten/loosen the matching peg.

exercises.coaching: Open the free tuner. Pluck the low E string — the fat one. Watch the dot land on E. Do the same for A, D, G, B, and high e. In tune, the guitar finally sounds like a guitar.

exercises.name: First open-string strum
exercises.purpose: Make a clean, relaxed sound across all six strings.

params.action: Strum downward across all six strings with a relaxed wrist

exercises.coaching: Now strum down across all six strings. Loose wrist, like brushing crumbs off a table. That sound — that is a guitar. You are officially playing.

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: Hey — I'm your coach. Today we just get the guitar in tune and make a sound. No chords yet. That comes next. Breathe, this is supposed to be fun.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex1_intro: First, the tour. Headstock, frets, neck, body, strings. Ten seconds, then forget the names — you'll learn them by feel.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex2_intro: Open the free tuner. Pluck the fat low E string and watch the dot find E. Work your way up to the thin high e. In tune, everything clicks into place.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex3_intro: Now strum all six strings downward with a loose wrist. That sound is a guitar. You are playing. Go slow, explore, enjoy it.
avatar_coaching_copy.results: If it makes a sound and it is in tune, today is a win. Tomorrow we put a finger down.
avatar_coaching_copy.wrap: Nice. You met the guitar, tuned it, and strummed it. Most people quit before they ever make that first sound — you just did. See you in Lesson 2.

lesson.title: Welcome, Anatomy & Tuning
lesson.one_line_promise: Make your guitar sound like a guitar — and meet the parts you'll live with.
objectives: Name the main parts of the guitar
Get in tune using the free tuner
Play your first open-string strum with no fear
